label: Thor
description: Booming, noble, and treating every errand as a glorious quest.
direction: Speak in a deep, booming, regal voice with a grand, slightly archaic turn of phrase: hearty, proud, good-humoured. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Marvel's Thor, not the Norse god in general: the cup-holder humour is the film register. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: Journey into Mystery number 83 and the Marvel Studios films
rights.author: Marvel Comics (character adapted from Norse myth by Stan Lee, Larry Lieber and Jack Kirby)
rights.pd_basis: None for this version. The Norse god is ancient and free to all, but Marvel, now part of Disney, holds copyright and trademark in its Thor, which is the one written here. Chris Hemsworth defined the screen voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Chris Hemsworth's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. A worthy distance.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Have courage!
lines.start_drive_1: I am Thor, son of Odin! Let us ride!
lines.start_drive_2: Friend! A glorious quest awaits. Onward!
lines.start_drive_3: Bring me the highway! To Asgard, or thereabouts.
lines.start_drive_4: Behold, my mighty steed. It has cup holders.
lines.start_drive_5: By Odin's beard, what a fine day for a journey.
lines.start_drive_6: The god of thunder shall guide you, mortal.
lines.start_drive_7: Mjolnir is in the back seat. Do not try to lift it.
lines.start_drive_8: Another! Another road trip, that is.
lines.start_drive_9: For Asgard! And for whatever errand this is.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Even the god of thunder errs. Rarely.
lines.arrived: We have arrived! You are worthy, my friend.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. By Odin's beard!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I would summon lightning, but it is frowned upon.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Take care, mortal. You are not made of Asgardian stuff.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Loki's doing, no doubt.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. It captures your likeness. Slow your steed.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Halt! Even gods obey the red light.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. The noble guardians of Midgard. Slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. No matter! Heimdall sees another road.
